newsitem.title: USA: Redwood Trust files $300 mln equity shelf.
newsitem.headline: Redwood Trust files $300 mln equity shelf.

text.p: Redwood Trust Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $300 million in preferred shares, preferred stock warrants, common shares and common stock warrants.

The Mill Valley, Calif. company that acquires and management real estate mortgage loans said proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repaying oustanding debt or future acquisitions.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
